tags.name: Respondent verification
tags.description: Minimal read-only user and session tab-liveness verification contracts.

get.description: Returns only the user ID and whether the account is active or suspended.

post.summary: Verify a respondent session is live
post.description: Resolves the per-client authorization SID to (account, client) and passes only if a logged-in tab on that same account+client is open and visible (a live Session row with a fresh heartbeat). Tab-liveness, not human presence: an unattended but open tab counts.
